column9: This list; a second press closes it.
Tabs: SUPER+ALT+H / SUPER+ALT+L switch the tab, SUPER+ALT+SHIFT+hjkl moves a window into a group, SUPER+CTRL+Y out of it.

column3: Move window out of its group

column9: hjkl resize, any other key leaves the mode.

column3: Close window (twice for browsers and terminals)

column9: wl-kbptr: type the label of a grid cell, bisect the area with the on-screen labels, then g / h / b click left / right / middle (Space or Enter only move the pointer; Backspace goes one step back). Runs on the us layout and restores your layout afterwards.

column3: Pointer hint drag: select or move by keyboard
column9: Pick the start point, then the end point: the pointer presses, moves and releases (text selection, drag and drop).

column3: Mouse mode (hjkl move - space click - Esc leave)
column9: h j k l move the pointer, H J K L move it in big steps, Space or Enter left click, r right click, m middle click, y / u scroll down / up, f jump by label, Esc or q or any other key leaves.
dunst context menu of the visible notification (its actions and URLs). It is drawn with the dmenu command from dunstrc (rofi today).

column1: # V1b: menus on the shared modal fzf (INSERT / NORMAL, Ctrl+j/k, Esc, ua/ru twins).

column9: nmcli list with signal and security; Enter connects (a new secured network asks for the password in a themed pinentry), Alt+d / d forgets the saved profile, Alt+r / r switches the radio, Alt+s / s rescans.
Drives the INSERT / NORMAL modal (incl. the Cyrillic twins) in a private tmux server. doctor.sh runs the same check.
The hidden ghostty on the special workspace "menu" answers menus in ~40 ms. Restart it after changing the fzf library or ghostty config.
